name: armor_floor_quarter
description: Armour never takes more than three quarters of a hit (design 3.2: dealt = max(raw - armour, raw / 4)): the Frost Spire's 4 damage does 1 to the Bristlesow (armour 6) and 1 to a Thornback (armour 4), and an 8-damage arrow does 2 to the Bristlesow, where armour would have left nothing or less than a quarter.

steps.msg: the Bristlesow, armour 6, stands in reach of both towers
4 against armour 6 still does a quarter: 1
8 against armour 6 does 2, which is also its quarter
4 against armour 4 would be nothing; the floor leaves 1
where armour leaves more than a quarter, it is plain subtraction
